task: Chat with a small language model privately on this computer

x-display.title: Chat with a local AI model
x-display.summary: Chat in your browser with an AI model running on your computer through Ollama.
x-display.description:
Use a local chat workspace for questions, drafting or exploring ideas. This package brings together Open WebUI, Ollama and a small model, so the chat interface and the software that answers you run on the same computer.

You return to the app for later conversations. It is a running service rather than a task that produces one output file.

packaging_note: Unmodified Open WebUI and Ollama images. A first-use download retrieves the Qwen2.5 1.5B model from Ollama.

access.why: Ollama downloads the model on first use. Chat requests use the local Ollama service.

known_issues: The first start downloads about 4–5 GB. Allow 20 GB of free space on the drive where UGT is installed so it can unpack the apps and the model. Later starts use the local copies.
Chat runs on your CPU. This small model can be slow and can give wrong answers.

An earlier installation can spend minutes loading browser tools before its first reply. In Admin settings, open Models, Model Defaults, then Model Capabilities. Leave Builtin Tools off and select Save to apply the setting to new conversations.
Single-user, no login. Chat history and models are stored in local Docker volumes.

If a Linux browser shows an empty conversation after you send a message, add ?lang=en-US to the chat address and reopen it. Open WebUI cannot display some system language settings, such as en-US@POSIX. Your saved answer is still there.
